data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Kadira means 'eternal' or 'everlasting'. This name holds a special significance in Islamic culture, reminding us of the enduring nature of faith and the eternal rewards of the Hereafter. The name Kadira carries the meaning “Eternal, Everlasting” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kadira usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal, everlasting and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Naming a child Kadira emphasizes a deep connection to the everlasting essence of faith and its continuity through generations. In a world marked by instability and impermanence, embracing a name like Kadira serves as a reminder of the eternal nature of our beliefs and the enduring impact of our actions in this life and in the Hereafter.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic faith, the name Kadira carries deep spiritual significance. It is a constant reminder of the infinite nature of Allah’s (God’s) mercy and the eternal rewards awaiting us in the Hereafter. The name inspires a sense of determination to strive towards righteousness and serve Allah faithfully, as the pleasures and treasures of this world are transient, while the fruits of our religious labor will last for eternity. Additionally, Kadira encourages patience and forbearance in the face of adversity, as we trust that Allah’s plan for us is eternal and worthwhile.
